preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 500.
The number of stacks N for each test case must be between 1 and 50.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= len(B) <= 50 and all(c in '01' for c in B)
preconditions.description: Each stack B must be a binary string of length between 1 and 50.
The starting player S must be either 'Dee' or 'Dum'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Dee' if starting_player == 'Dee' and winning_strategy == 'Dee' else stdout == 'Dum'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'Dee' if Tweedle-Dee wins, otherwise 'Dum'.
